summary: Iteration 134: QBR Auto-Generator testing complete. All 23 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified working - QBR page loads with client/quarter selectors, generates AI-drafted 6-section reviews using Claude Sonnet 4.5, displays KPI strip with 5 cards, allows editing all sections, saves to database, and provides PDF download. Regression tests for Blueprints Library and Pattern Discovery passed.
seed_data_creation: Using existing client-001 (Acme Corporation) and ticket data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 134 added QBR Auto-Generator: (1) GET /api/qbr/{client_id}?quarter=YYYY-QN generates AI-drafted QBR with stats and 6 sections using Claude Sonnet 4.5. (2) Without quarter param, defaults to most recently completed quarter. (3) POST /api/qbr/{client_id}/save persists QBR to db.qbrs. (4) GET /api/qbr/{client_id}/list returns saved QBRs sorted by saved_at desc. (5) GET /api/qbrs/{qbr_id} returns full saved QBR. (6) GET /api/qbrs/{qbr_id}/pdf?token=... returns branded PDF (token auth via query param). (7) Frontend /qbr page has client+quarter selectors, KPI strip (5 cards), editable 6-section view, save button, PDF download button after save, and history list. (8) Pattern-aware: stats.pattern_hits populated when cross-client patterns exist. (9) Navigation: QBRs added under Business section between Revenue Growth and War Rooms.

qbr_generate_with_quarter.details: GET /api/qbr/client-001?quarter=2026-Q1 returns full QBR with stats (tix_total, by_priority, top_issues, sla_breaches, resolved_this_q, devices, backup, critical_alerts, spend, pattern_hits) and AI-generated sections (executive_summary, key_wins, incident_breakdown, infrastructure_health, risks_and_recommendations, msp_intelligence, next_quarter_focus).

qbr_generate_default_quarter.details: GET /api/qbr/client-001 without quarter param defaults to most recently completed quarter.

qbr_invalid_quarter.details: GET /api/qbr/client-001?quarter=invalid returns 400 with 'quarter must be YYYY-Q[1-4]'.

qbr_save.details: POST /api/qbr/client-001/save with quarter+sections persists to db.qbrs and returns {id, client_id, client_name, quarter, stats, sections, saved_at, saved_by}.

qbr_list.details: GET /api/qbr/client-001/list returns saved QBRs sorted by saved_at desc, excluding sections and stats.

qbr_get.details: GET /api/qbrs/{qbr_id} returns full saved QBR with all fields.

qbr_pdf.details: GET /api/qbrs/{qbr_id}/pdf?token=... returns 200 application/pdf with %PDF-1.3 header. Token auth via query param.

frontend_qbr_page.details: QBR page loads with data-testid='qbr-page'. Client selector (qbr-client-select), quarter selector (qbr-quarter-select), and generate button (qbr-generate-btn) present.

frontend_qbr_generation.details: Generate QBR button triggers AI generation. Draft appears with all 6 sections editable. KPI strip shows 5 cards (Tickets, Critical, Devices Online, SLA breaches, Spend).

frontend_qbr_save_pdf.details: Save button (qbr-save-btn) persists QBR. PDF download button (qbr-pdf-btn) appears after save.

frontend_qbr_sections.details: All section testids verified: qbr-section-executive, qbr-section-wins, qbr-section-focus, qbr-section-incidents, qbr-section-infra, qbr-section-intelligence.

frontend_qbr_history.details: Recent QBRs history shown in empty state with PDF download per row.

regression_blueprints_library.details: Blueprints Library tab still shows table of blueprints correctly.

regression_blueprints_patterns.details: Pattern Discovery tab still works with patterns panel.

notes: QBR generation uses Claude Sonnet 4.5 (claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929) via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY. AI generation takes 30-60 seconds. PDF uses fpdf with _safe() unicode sanitizer for latin-1 compatibility. Pattern-aware feature bridges with blueprints router _bigrams/_tokens functions.
